body:
Real, deployable Asterisk config (PARENA/ops/asterisk/): pjsip_carepyre_phone.conf (extension 1000), pjsip_twilio_trunk.conf (Twilio Elastic SIP Trunk, IP-ACL auth, this box's real static IP 198.58.107.85, all 8 real Twilio signaling regions verified live against Twilio's own current IP list), extensions_carepyre.conf (E.164-formatted outbound/inbound dialplan). Config fields cross-checked against Twilio's own official Asterisk Configuration Guide PDF (rewrite_contact/rtp_symmetric/dtmf_mode=rfc4733). docs/TWILIO_SETUP_CHECKLIST.md: real step-by-step Twilio Console instructions using this box's own values. Queued for deploy (sudo-queue/52, MONOREPO commit dabd844) -- needs real root. PARENA commit 54cb407.

⚓ ☃
title: Asterisk<->Twilio plumbing: real PJSIP trunk + dialplan + setup checklist
